package.description: The last terminal you will ever need — a modern SSH/remote session manager.

en-US.description: The last terminal you will ever need — a modern SSH/remote session manager.
en-US.longDescription:
Ternix is a modern, feature-rich SSH and remote session manager built with Electron.
It supports SSH, serial, RDP and SFTP connections with a sleek, fast interface.
Features include split panes, session recording, tunneling, and more.
en-US.name: Ternix
